description: This Java file defines the LogView class, a custom Android UI component that extends TextView and implements LogNode. It is used to display log messages received via the LogNode interface, formatting log details and appending them to the view, with support for different log levels, exception stack traces, and chaining to other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log messages, and displaying them within the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including handling of log levels, tags, message text, and exceptions; ensures thread-safe UI updates; propagates log message to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
